name: The Great Hunger
description: A festering strain of the Black Grail. Ravenous thralls, Hunger Strains, and the monstrous Matagot Hag.
add_rules: Spawn of Gluttony: Must include 1 Matagot Hag. Cannot include Lord of Tumours, Corpse Guards, Grail Thralls, Heralds of Beelzebub, or Amalgam.

Eternal Appetence: At the start of each Turn, choose one effect for your warband (lasts until end of Turn): Agonised Churning (activate friendly within 8" of Hag with 2+ INFECTION MARKERS → remove 2 and place on enemy within 1" without ARTIFICIAL/DEMONIC), Ruinous Masticating (place 1 INFECTION MARKER on each friendly within 8" of Hag; opponent cannot spend friendly INFECTION MARKERS for -DICE on melee if model has 2+), Spasmodic Wretching (place 1 INFECTION MARKER on each friendly within 8" of Hag; -1 DICE to Ranged Attacks targeting friendlies with 2+ INFECTION MARKERS), or Vile Craving (activate friendly within 8" of Hag with 2+ INFECTION MARKERS → remove 2 and move up to half Movement, max 4", towards nearest enemy).

Butcher Knights: Plague Knights gain Ravenous Infection ACTION free (see Ravenous). Must be on 32mm or 40mm bases. Ranks replaced with: Butcher King (10d, earn 1 Glory if not OoA and took enemy OoA in melee), Knight Companion of the Feast (5d, +1 DICE to Ravenous Infection Risky rolls for friendly within 3"), Knight of Twin Cleavers (5d, IGNORE OFF-HAND + melee gains SHRAPNEL).
Cradle of Filth: 0-3 Cradle Thralls. Use Ravenous entry but INFILTRATOR, cost 2 Glory (no ducats), do not count towards Maximum Field Strength.

Desiccated Husks: 0-2 Desiccated Husks. Use Corpse Guard entry but melee gains CRITICAL, Bodyguard replaced by More Worm Than Man (opponent cannot spend this model's INFECTION MARKERS unless converting to Bloodbath).
The Great Maw: If warband total cost is 1000d+, can recruit 0-1 Great Maws. Uses Lord of Tumours entry without LEADER keyword.

Excruciating Hunger: Cannot have Beelzebub's Axe, Black Grail Shields, Bolt-Action Rifles, Blunderbusses, Compound Eyes Helmets, Corruption Belchers, Gas Grenades, Infested Rifles, Machine Guns, Musical Instruments, Muskets, Pistols, Troop Flags, or Viscera Cannons.
Hunger Strains: Any model can have 1 Strain; Ravenous can have up to 3. Purchased on recruit or in Quartermaster Step. Cannot be removed or lost.
Ravenous Infection ACTION: Plague Knights and Ravenous can take this. Risky Success Roll — on Success, place 1 INFECTION MARKER on any model within 1". Activation ends immediately regardless.

abilities: Cadre of Flesh: If hit by Ranged/Melee Attack, a friendly Ravenous within 3" can take the hit instead. If BLAST, make Injury Roll for Hag before other models.
Frenzied Followers: +1 DICE to Risky Dash rolls for friendly models within 8".

Mother's Call ACTION: Remove any number of INFECTION MARKERS from models (friend/foe) within 18". For each removed, command 1 Ravenous within 8": Feast (Ravenous Infection + extra marker), Fight (+1 DICE melee), or Follow (Move, no Charge/Retreat). Max 1 Command per model per Turn.
Pestilent: Melee Attack with INFECTION MARKERS and CRITICAL without a weapon. Melee attacks place 1 extra INFECTION MARKER on target.
Undead Fortitude: -1 INJURY DICE unless FIRE.
add_units.battlekit_notes: Can only have Cup of Filth, Grail Devotees, and/or Foetid Palanquin. No other Battlekit.

abilities: Gluttonous Horde: Can make Melee Attack with CRITICAL without a weapon. +1 DICE per friendly model within 3" of attacker.
Ravenous Infection ACTION: Risky Success Roll — on Success, place 1 INFECTION MARKER on any model within 1". Activation ends immediately.
Undead Fortitude: -1 INJURY DICE unless FIRE.
add_units.battlekit_notes: Cannot have any Battlekit. Can have up to 3 Hunger Strains.
unit_upgrades: Lockjaw Bite (Infection Marker on enemy Retreat)
Papillal Hide (no LoS needed for Charge)
Matagot Hag, Great Maw, Desiccated Husks, Ravenous only
Devouring Jaws (Devour ACTION: melee with CRITICAL)

abilities: Dormant Hunger: Once per Turn, when taken Out of Action, go dormant instead. Replace with 60mm Impassable terrain marker. Friendly Ravenous finishing move within 1" is consumed to revive (set up Down). Counts as OoA for Morale/Trauma.
Gnashing and Tearing: Melee Attack without weapon with +1 INJURY DICE, INFECTION MARKERS, CLEAVE 2. If charged this activation, replace CLEAVE 2 with CLEAVE 3.
Plague-Ridden Flesh: -2 INJURY DICE unless FIRE.
Unholy Gut: Can purchase Vomitus weapon for 40d (cannot be lost in campaign).
unit_upgrades: Vomitus (8" line attack, +1 INJ MOD, ASSAULT, INFECTION MARKERS)
